description: List work categories used to classify work orders and requests. Each has a `module`: facilities, infrastructure, or null (shared by both). Pick a category whose module matches the work - infrastructure for work on a feature, facilities otherwise - or a shared one.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.
